title: I-QMapper: Error-Aware Layout Optimization and Device Diagnostics for NISQ Hardware
summary: Achieving high-fidelity execution on noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) hardware requires careful selection of physical qubit layouts, as gate errors, readout errors, and coherence times vary across the device and drift over time. Currently, qubit mapping is performed either through manual inspection of device calibration data or through automated layout pipelines, neither of which provides integrated, interactive layout visualization combined with calibration analytics.
